title: Words and lines to read (lesson 50)
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Al-'Adiyat, Az-Zalzalah and reading from the mushaf
source: Seeded from quran/y2 lesson 50 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words and lines to read)
intro: Lesson 50: Reading from the mushaf: stopping on tanween. To understand how to stop on a word that ends in tanween when reading from the mushaf

questions.q: Read 100:1 to 3 from the mushaf, stopping at each circle.
questions.a: dabhaa, qadhaa, subhaa at the stops.
questions.model: I do: wal-'aadiyaati dabhaa (stop), fal-mooriyaati qadhaa (stop).

questions.q: Pupil PDF: read the ten ayah endings of Al-'Adiyat; tick each one you stop on correctly. The teacher listens to today's group.
questions.a: Endings read with the right stop.
questions.model: The teacher reads «ضَبْحًۭا» as dabhaa and ticks it.

questions.q: find the word with fathatan in Al-Humazah 104:2.
questions.a: مَالًۭا (104:2): maalan joined, maalaa at a stop

questions.q: Back to our ponder: In Al-'Adiyat many ayat end with ـًا. When we stop, do we say the 'n' sound?
questions.a: No. On fathatan we stop with a long 'aa': dabhaa, qadhaa, subhaa.
